entities.name: Rafael de la Barra Tagle
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rafael Victor de la Barra Tagle was a Chilean Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Illapel from 1989 to 2010. De la Barra Tagle died on 9 October 2025, at the age of 94.
